newsitem.title: GERMANY: German May plant and equipment orders fall 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: German May plant and equipment orders fall 11 pct.

text.p: German plant construction and equipment orders dipped by a real 11 percent in May from year ago levels, industry association VDMA said.
The group said domestic orders fell 13 percent while foreign orders fell nine percent in the month of May compared with May 1996 levels.
In the three-month period March through May orders matched year-ago levels on a real basis. Domestic orders dropped three percent while foreign orders rose two percent.
